physical_anchor: Manufactures photonic quantum-computing systems (the Dirac series) built on its own thin-film lithium-niobate (TFLN) photonic-chip foundry — physical hardware.
value_chain_position: Qubit hardware platform layer (photonic) plus an in-house TFLN photonic-chip foundry — a vertically-integrated small-cap spanning the photonics and qubit-hardware layers, pre-commercial revenue funded by dated program/pilot contracts.
